description: Land Title Settlement Department - Thariyanka, Nuwaragampalatha East D/S Division, Anuradhapura District - Cad. Map No. 110198 (23/0623)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination regarding specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, locations, and ownership details) by the Commissioner of Title Settlement. The content focuses on land ownership, title registration, and property determinations, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it primarily concerns land and property-related administrative matters.
